note: Gameplay approximations of the laws in force in Lebanon on 1 January 2000; choices are judgements, not checked line by line against a fetched source. Elections: competitive confessional elections under an electoral law that favoured established blocs (restricted_elections). Economy: a largely private, trade-oriented economy (free_market). Trade: open trade (free_trade). Conscription: compulsory military service of limited scope (selective_conscription; the scope was not checked). Religion: confessional personal-status law with no state religion (religious_law_partial). Press: privately owned media with state oversight (regulated_press).
